stations.title: Winnie
stations.say: Who is Biscuit? The phone's ringing.

stations.title: Practice database
stations.text: Every owner, animal and visit, in SQLite.
stations.note: Only Ifan knows how to ask it.

captions: At Hollybank Vets, Winnie has a caller on the line and no idea who Biscuit is.
The answer is in the practice's database, but only Ifan can ask it, and he is in surgery.
You write your first queries, in three tasks: animals, owners and a broken query to fix.
Now every animal is on Winnie's screen, and Biscuit is one row in it.
Same database, no waiting. The front desk can see its own records.
